name: Teldrassil: The Burden of the Kaldorei

summary: This quest sends young night elves across Teldrassil to draw water from the island's most sacred moonwell beneath the ancient Oracle Tree. Entrusted by Corithras Moonrage, travelers witness firsthand the spiritual vitality meant to sustain their new home and observe the deep connection between the well waters and the healing boughs of the great World Tree.

sections.title: Water of the Oracle Glade
sections.body: Corithras Moonrage directs adventurers far to the northwest of Teldrassil to the serene Oracle Glade. Tucked deep beneath the great canopy sits the Oracle Tree and the first, most potent moonwell consecrated upon the new World Tree. Drawing water into an Amethyst Phial, travelers are meant to touch the heart of night elf sacred tradition, tapping into waters deeply suffused with the blessings of the goddess Elune.

sections.title: A Stunted Recovery
sections.body: Upon meeting Corithras outside the gates of Darnassus, the druid shares troubled insights gleaned from the Oracle Tree. While Teldrassil survived its creation and initial blessings, its vigor remains strangely hindered. The druids and ancient spirits watching over the canopy fear that despite their purification rituals, a lingering taint or deep corruption persists within the trunk, threatening the future of the Kaldorei sanctuary.

faq.q: Why is the moonwell at the Oracle Tree so important?
faq.answer: It is the very first and most powerful moonwell created on Teldrassil. Located beneath the ancient Oracle Tree in the far northwest, its waters hold the purest concentration of Elune's divine energy on the island.

Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar and mystic stationed along the road near Darnassus. He guides promising adventurers through the spiritual history and lingering perils surrounding Teldrassil's unorthodox creation.

faq.q: What is wrong with Teldrassil's growth?
faq.answer: Despite receiving blessings and tending by the Cenarion Circle, Teldrassil's vitality remains stunted. The druids monitoring the island through the Oracle Tree suspect a hidden corruption still festers inside the boughs, preventing the tree from truly thriving.

faq.q: Where does Corithras wait after I fill the phial?
faq.answer: After you fill the Amethyst Phial at the Oracle Glade, Corithras leaves his earlier post and waits for you along the main crossroads just outside the eastern gates of Darnassus.

angles.text: Fetching the waters of the first moonwell is an initiation into the fragile balance of your people's newest home and the hidden rot that endangers it.
The druids of the Cenarion Circle created Teldrassil to restore harmony, making the discovery of its stunted health deeply concerning to your order.
The holy waters of the Oracle Glade represent the purest manifestation of Elune's grace on Teldrassil, central to the rites of the Sisterhood.
